headline: B4 built b4wave with three flag-gated platform-DSP augmentation levers. They are WebRTC NS (apm_ns), webrtcvad DTX gating (dtx_gate) and libopus packet loss + PLC (opus_plc), plus a mechanism readout calibrated on a 9-run null panel. All static, regression, smoke and compat checks pass. B2f re-scores with max |dlogit| 0, and levers-off matches the base trainer exactly with the augmenter off. The recommended wave is ~14 h. One owner decision is pending: dtx_gate under-doses its target (smoke dose ratio ~0.027 vs the 0.25 rule).

levers.smoke: PASS (tests/facts.json): time x 1.126 vs levers-off, peak 9.94 GiB (= S0), projected 4.66 h. wrtc_ns on 218/758 codec calls = 0.288 (bona 0.306, spoof 0.283; computed from tests/smoke/S_apm_ns.log), no fail counters, selftest PASS (no_hpf -0.09..-0.92 dB, aligned lag 0).

Mechanism 'shown' bar NS DiD <= -0.22, refuted at >= +0.32. Lower-p retry only if shown without the run-anomaly flag.

recommended_wave.name: B4
recommended_wave.notes: Training 12.28 h from the smoke projections (4.66 + 3.78 + 3.84, tests/facts.json) plus ~0.6 h eval and analysis per arm (B3a timing in exploop/B3/events.jsonl). Each arm is one flag off B2f at --batch_size 16 with the b4wave.train entry; rules are band +-0.5, promote = CI low > 0 and clean drop <= 0.5. The analyst runs scripts/b4_dsp_slices.py per arm and readout with --ref B2f, --placebo <other arms> and --lever, and the wave SUMMARY re-runs it with --summary to issue final verdicts. dtx_gate goes last so the owner can decide its dose; as built it can show but not refute the mechanism, and it still serves as a placebo arm. The opus_plc zero-loss control (~3.8 h) runs only if opus_plc is positive on WF1. Optional B2f replicate arm ~4.1 h. Smoke is 'off' in the seed, which is valid only for code sha d163f934; any code change needs a new smoke.

owner_questions: dtx_gate: run as built (expected 'inconclusive (under-dosed)'; still a placebo arm), or commission a higher-dose code variant first (e.g. hangover U(0,200) ms or a forced aggressive mode)? Raising --aug_dtx_p does not change the dose ratio.
Add the critic's optional B2f replicate arm (b4wave, all levers off, ~4.1 h) as the same-config null and extra placebo?
F2.1: confirm the dtx_gate falsifier (1) escape metric: WF1 (plan text, implemented) or heldout F1 (O3.2 wording)?
Accept the per-profile (pooled) reading of the opus_plc zero-loss attribution check (one clip below 15 dB per clip)?
Wave order: apm_ns -> opus_plc -> dtx_gate (recommended) or the seed order apm_ns -> dtx_gate -> opus_plc?
Install conda-forge libopus in rtc-sdd before the wave to harden opus_plc against container restarts?
risks: dtx_gate is structurally under-dosed: smoke 2/233 clips >=20% gated (dose ratio ~0.027 vs the 0.25 rule); even forced mode 3 gates a mean 0.082/0.069 vs a held-out mean of 0.233. A null arm cannot refute the mechanism.

Promotion needs spill-over: ~14 fewer noisy bona FA are needed to clear the +-0.5 band, while the per-lever stage deficits are 10.8 / 3.9 / 2.4+3.3 clips. Heldout F1 panel SD is 1.35, so single-seed outcome deltas below ~1 point are within cross-run spread.
B3 lesson 4: harder input-side augmentation cut the late fit. Guarded by the shared under-fit falsifier, but untested on B2f without consistency.
Placebo rule (e) depends on all three arms running. Verdicts are capped at 'directional' with 0 placebo arms, and there is no same-config B2f replicate.

opus_plc: the zero-loss attribution passes only per profile (per-clip qq 14.78 / wechat 12.96 dB), and there is a ~69-sample ffmpeg pre-skip offset; both are covered by the zero-loss control arm. LOC (~383) is near the 400 cap.
A container restart wipes system ffmpeg and libopus. opus_plc then raises at start-up; the wave preflight reinstalls ffmpeg.

Smoke time factors are noisy (dtx 0.928 and opus 0.913 below 1; apm 1.126 vs a CPU projection of 1.012-1.049), and the 1% smoke losses differ between passes of the same config (pid-seeded augmenter RNG, hypothesis).

The first GPU pass was blocked: R1_old_scores 'local_eval exited 1' with no recorded cause, and the augmenter-on equivalence failed. The re-run passed, with the equivalence now augmenter-off. The manifest was re-baselined by the owner at both unblocks.
B2f is not the numerically best run (B3a 93.06/92.94 at 7.87 GPU-h). Gains on B2f may not transfer, and stacking consistency breaks the 1.3x epoch cap.
